title: The free energy principle holds only for a narrow class of systems

statements.text: In weakly coupled linear stochastic systems, the Markov blanket condition and the restrictions on solenoidal flows that the free energy principle needs hold only in a very narrow space of parameters, and its step to variational inference rests on an implicit equivalence of averages.
statements.scope: aimed at the classical free energy principle, which the quantum formulation generalizes

sources.quote: are only valid for a very narrow space of parameters
